name: Shimakaze Minshuku
description: A bright, woodblock-print hospitality theme for a six-room island guesthouse. Kobai plum pink (#E16B8C) fills the hero, every page head and the footer, with woodblock indigo bands, blush paper and plum ink text; Dela Gothic One for display over M PLUS 1p. The art is ukiyo-e woodblock raster illustration (the inn, the harbour, a tatami room, a dinner tray, the coast road), with the inn and the dinner tray as transparent cut-outs that break out of their frames. A full top header: a deep plum strip with a Book a room button, then the menu split into two halves either side of the centred inn name. The home page is a split screen: the plum field with the title and the cut-out inn crossing the split line beside a grid of rooms and plans with prices, then dinner on an indigo band, the synced rates card, the island and the journal. The rates card and the inn details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-11 (split-screen, product-grid-hero, split nav, cutout-break-frame, woodblock, kobai #E16B8C, Dela Gothic One + M PLUS 1p). Contrast: plum ink #2B1B24 on kobai #E16B8C 5.2:1 (body text on the plum fields), white on deep plum #9E2F50 strip 6.4:1, deep plum on blush 6.3:1, plum ink on blush 14.6:1, blush #FFF6F4 on indigo #22304F 12.3:1, petal pink #F5A9BC on indigo 7.0:1. White on kobai is 3.1:1, so white is never used on the kobai fields.

fonts.role: display: headings, the inn name, prices and the footer mark

summary.zh-TW: 鮮明的浮世繪木刻風島嶼民宿網站：紅梅色分割畫面，去背的民宿插畫破框而出，旁邊是房型與方案價格方格。
summary.en: A bright woodblock island guesthouse site: a plum split screen with the cut-out inn breaking its frame beside a grid of rooms and rates.
summary.ja: 木版画風の島の民宿サイト。紅梅色の分割画面から切り抜きの宿が枠を越え、横に部屋とプランの料金グリッドが並びます。
summary.fr: Un site de maison d’hôtes insulaire en estampe : un écran partagé rose prune, l’auberge détourée qui déborde et la grille des chambres.
summary.de: Eine Inselpension im Holzschnitt-Stil: geteilter Pflaumen-Screen, ausgeschnittenes Gasthaus über dem Rahmen, daneben Zimmer und Preise.
